cohort: Reuse the 2729 training-only v1 stations; no test-based filtering.
original_march_test_status: Previously opened; may now be development/training data, never called an untouched test again.
original_service_goal_feasibility: On v1 test R0=95.1761%, so +5pp exceeds 100%. Do not relabel this goal as achieved.
selection: Screen candidates on March1-14, refit diverse top classical candidates and all four small neural candidates on Jan-March, select on April1-14, freeze all choices before evaluating April15-May14 once.

thresholds.state_conditioned_thresholds: Optimize two thresholds on validation only, current zero vs current positive.

recommendation.diagnostic_subgroup: Nearest eligible current-positive candidate has quantity1-3 at input time; report unchanged full-validation-selected policies. Does not replace primary whole-query goals.

controls.R1u: B1 calibrated on Apr1-7 plus the SAME risk/distance utility and Apr8-14 weight selection as R2

recommendation.uncertainty: Exploratory 2000-bootstrap intervals by whole input day, paired by date/input_time/origin_id, R2 minus R0/R1u/Rq. Policies fixed before test; not a new optimization target.

restrictions: Static target-encoded predictor transforms fit training labels only; designated validation days may fit calibration. Online transition features use only observed transitions q(t-1) -> q(t), never future q(t+1).
No retuning after the new final test
Do not equate archived zero quantity with actual rental failure
Report search budget and data windows rather than claiming equal tuning budget
checkpoint_selection: Original B1 keeps v1 logloss checkpoint selection. Initial screening uses logloss. After class-weighting diagnostics, unfinished screen LightGBM candidates and forward research LightGBM candidates may select checkpoints by validation-only binned F1, followed by exact validation threshold search. Completed screening records are preserved; the new test never selects iterations.
additional_methods: After early validation diagnostics, causal past-transition encodings and four small CPU neural classifiers were added before any new test evaluation. Original 98-feature groups stay unchanged; hazard groups add seven causal encodings.

weather_sensitivity.source: KMA ASOS Seoul108 2025 hourly archive; 8760 rows
weather_sensitivity.limitation: Historical archive may contain revisions; live publication latency and matching vintage are unverified. Timestamp-causal archived sensitivity, not verified live availability.

forward_candidate_selection: Best six distinct (learner kind, input group) representations on screening validation; keep best CatBoost, XGBoost, state experts, archived weather; original B1 controls and tuned B1; all four small neural models. Within-family depths/leaves competed in screening.
